visualCharacteristics.purpose: Thin family-of-brands strip with right-aligned logo links (H&R Block, Block Advisors, Spruce), the current brand highlighted

contentPattern.structure: one row with one cell per brand (or one cell with a paragraph per brand); each brand is a link wrapping a logo image/icon (or plain link text). Mark the current brand with `(active)` in its text or by bolding it; a same-origin link to `/` is also treated as current

usage: Use at the very top of expat resource pages for the cross-brand strip. Logos are kept as authored (SVG logos are never re-optimized). Only one item is highlighted as current. The bar keeps its own dark strip on light sections and turns transparent on dark section Styles (forest, green, bright-green, black).
reuseGuidance: Reuse for any small row of sister-brand or partner logo links. Not a replacement for the site header navigation.
